notes.content:

notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

FOR THE KING II

We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

SPACE CREW

Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for FREE and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends March 13th!
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


WOBBLY LIFE

We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on GeForce Now!

What GeForce Now is:[

GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

What else is going on?

We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is coming soon! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: Summer Sale 2023
notes.content:
Summer has arrived, bringing with it the warmth of sunshine and the excitement of this sizzling Summer Sale! As the days get longer and the temperature rises, there's no better time to dive into some thrilling gaming adventures and enjoy fantastic deals. 

Embrace the spirit of the season with our incredible discounts on all titles in our vast catalog. We have something for everyone, whether you're craving action, adventure, or strategy. Enjoy captivating and exciting games like Human Fall Flat, The Ascent, Blooming Business: Casino, From Space, and the adventurous Patch Quest.  

So, grab your sunglasses, controller, mouse & keyboard, and get ready for a very hot gaming summer! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/854f506495036857d1dff23e769c6769033079d9.png

Badlands Crew  

Join the crew and become a protector of The Citadel!  

Customize your battle wagon with a wide range of components and weapons, transforming it into a formidable force. Manage your crew's actions individually in combat, from manning guns to repairing vehicle components. Navigate hazardous environments and face off against savage militia groups led by crazed Warlords. Make strategic decisions that shape the campaign map and influence faction control.  

Your choices and skills will determine your success, plan wisely and fight fiercely! Wishlist and start your adventure into the lawless Badlands!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078230/

Dungeons of Hinterberg  

Grab your sword and prepare for an unforgettable adventure in the enchanting alpine village of Hinterberg!  

Join Luisa to conquer the mysterious Dungeons of Hinterberg. Immerse yourself in the breathtaking beauty of this idyllic Austrian Alps destination as you navigate the charming village and uncover the hidden magic within its dungeons. Prepare yourself for a vacation like no other, where adventure and magic intertwine in the alpine paradise.  

Wishlist and join Luisa on the path to becoming a Master Slayer! Welcome to Hinterberg, where the magic of the dungeons awaits your arrival! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983260/

Kitbash Model Club 

Welcome to the sun-kissed paradise of Wirraway Island! 

Prepare for an exhilarating adventure where innovation meets limitless possibilities. Here, you have the power to transform your most daring RC model construction dreams into tangible reality. Unleash your creativity and push the boundaries of performance.  

Wish list now and embark on this extraordinary journey today and watch as your imagination takes flight! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2107090/Kitbash_Model_Club/

Goblin Stone 

Attention, Gobbos! 

A new Dev Blog is out; check all the recent news about Goblin Stone and get ready to fight back! Goblins, orcs, and other monster folk rise against extinction. Wishlist now and join the Goblins in their fight for survival in this roguelike-turned-based RPG. Together, we will triumph! 

Onward, brave souls! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521970/Goblin_Stone/

For The King II  

Inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Prepare to confront Fahrul's once beloved Queen turned tyrant and her army of fearsome Queensguard in the highly anticipated sequel to For The King.  

Whether alone or with a party of four, unravel dark secrets, battle, loot and experience the thrill of this turn-based roguelike RPG.  Discover a host of fresh features, fearsome enemies and devilish dungeons across brand new epic campaigns.  Wishlist the game now and embark on a quest like no other. The Resistance is rising, join us Adventurers! 

Don’t miss the Curve bundles selection. Take advantage of this Sale, save money, and enjoy the spring season by adding some terrific games to your collection!

notes.title: Iron Fisticle Update 1.01 Out Now!
notes.content:
Good news Fisticle Fans!

We've updated Iron Fisticle to 1.01, fixing bugs, adding a new game mode and rebalancing the difficulty! The full patch notes are avialabe on the forums, but here are the headline changes:

- Three difficulty levels, each with their own leaderboards
- New Challenge mode
- Co-op mode, bosses and bonus game rebalanced
- Extra window scaling options and full menu controller support
- All achievements now unlock properly

Thanks to everyone who has contacted us or contributed to the forum thread with feedback and bug reports, it makes a huge difference.
